title: Dental PPO Plans Calculation Rules for a Reprocessed New-Plan-Wait Line
content:
The Dental PPO Plans calculate the plan payment and patient share of a line reprocessed after a denial for the new waiting period that followed a change to a plan covering its service class (a reprocessed new-plan-wait line) as follows.

> **Allowance and coinsurance.** The payment is figured on the line's allowed amount, at the plan's in-network percentage for the line's service class.
>
> **Waiting period.** The line is payable at the plan's level only when its date of service is at least its waiting period counted in whole calendar months from the plan change date (a month counting as whole when the day of the month of the date of service is not earlier than that of the plan change date, which always falls on the first of a month). The waiting period is the one for the line's service class that applies to the enrollment: the plan's individual waiting period for individual and individual exchange enrollments, its late-entrant waiting period for group enrollments of a late entrant, and none for other group enrollments or for preventive services. Until then the line remains denied and its plan payment is 0.00.
>
> **Deductible.** The plan's individual deductible less the person's deductible postings net of deductible reversals for the line's benefit year, never below zero and never more than the allowance the payment is figured on; a preventive-class line on a plan that waives the preventive deductible, or any line on a plan whose individual deductible is 0.00, takes none. Because every Cascade plan's family deductible maximum is three times its individual deductible, on an account with no more than three enrolled persons the family limit never falls below the person's own remaining deductible, so the line counts only the person's own deductible postings.
>
> **Normal benefit.** The allowance less the deductible taken, times the coinsurance, rounded to the cent with a half cent rounded up; the plan payment and patient share are rounded to the cent the same way.
>
> **Annual maximum.** The plan payment is never more than the person's remaining annual maximum for the line's benefit year (the plan's annual maximum less the person's maximum postings net of maximum reversals for that benefit year); for a person receiving the pediatric essential-health-benefit treatment (an individual exchange enrollment and a date of service before the person's pediatric age-limit birthday) no annual maximum applies.
>
> **Patient share.** The billed amount less the plan payment for a line from an out-of-network practice, and the allowed amount less the plan payment otherwise, never below zero.
>
> **Order.** The waiting-period test first; then the allowance and coinsurance give the normal benefit; then the annual-maximum ceiling gives the plan payment; the patient share last, its zero floor last.

**Worked figures (hypothetical).** Group late entrant; plan changed on 1 April to a plan with a 6-month late-entrant basic waiting period; basic line in network dated 3 October; allowed amount 244.10; individual deductible 50.00 with 50.00 posted (net); in-network basic coinsurance 90 percent; remaining annual maximum 1712.45.
- Whole months from 1 April to 3 October: 6, so the line is payable.
- Deductible taken: 0.00.
- Normal benefit: 244.10 times 90 percent, which is 219.69; plan payment 219.69.
- Patient share: 244.10 less 219.69, which is 24.41.

Dated 30 September instead, only 5 whole months have run: the line remains denied, the plan payment is 0.00 and the patient share is 244.10.
